description: A page of the directory as markdown: a listing's page with who it is for, what it does, when to use it, its files and its discussion; a business area's, a platform's or a tag's whole list; the Users Forum and Announcements channels and their threads. With no address it answers the first page, which says what the directory holds and links every business area. A file the pages link, such as the Agent Skills discovery index or the sitemap, comes as its text. A page longer than 60,000 characters comes in parts: a part that is not the last ends with a line that says which from reads the next part. A skill's file, at the address take lists for it, comes as its text, for an app that cannot fetch that address itself: the first line, in square brackets, states the file's size and SHA-256 and is not part of the file, and everything after it is the file as it is. Write it unchanged and check its SHA-256. A file that is not text, or is larger than 256 KB, is fetched at its address.

address.description: The page's address: a full address from a search result or a page's link, or its path, like `unpaid-invoice-chaser` or `skills/finance`. Absent for the first page. Or the address of a skill's file, as take lists it, like `unpaid-invoice-chaser/files/SKILL.md`.

from.description: The character to read from, as the last line of an earlier part says. 0 when absent.

name: read
title: Read a page
